title: English Practice Quiz 0789
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Which question asks for a reason?
I enjoy ___ books.
questions.explanation: Enjoy is followed by a gerund (-ing form).

questions.question: Please close ___ door.
questions.explanation: The refers to a specific door known to the speaker and listener.

questions.question: To confirm an instruction, you can say:
options: Could you please confirm the details?
questions.explanation: Could you please confirm... is polite and precise.

questions.question: She is the ___ student in the class.
questions.explanation: Use the superlative tallest when comparing one with the whole class.

questions.question: What is the meaning of 'available'?
options: ready or able to be used
questions.explanation: Available means ready for use or accessible.

questions.question: A professional way to ask for a file is:
options: Could you please share the file?
questions.explanation: Could you please is a polite and professional request.

questions.question: I have ___ friends in this city.
questions.explanation: A few is used with countable plural nouns.

questions.question: A person you can trust is ___.
Read: 'The shop closes at 9 p.m., but it opens at 10 a.m.' When does it open?
questions.explanation: The opening time given is 10 a.m.
